sections.heading: 1. Website Usage
sections.body: By accessing this website, you agree to comply with these terms of use. The website provides information about recruitment services, job listings, and career resources.

sections.heading: 2. Candidate Representations
sections.body: Candidates agree that all information provided in CVs, registration forms, and applications is accurate, current, and truthful.

sections.heading: 3. Client Agreements
sections.body: Employer recruitment terms, guarantee periods, and fee schedules are governed by separate signed client service agreements.
